title: Thin ambient SQLite and Neon routing for Propodus Vercel integration
intent: Implement the Dactyl-owned thin physical storage seam for local SQLite versus Propodus Vercel/Neon: preserve the existing public execution signature and local behavior, select the route only from the documented ambient configuration, forward the opaque StorageContext without tenancy or governance semantics, normalize stable typed outcomes, and publish one reviewable PR with local and mock proof while recording live deployment proof as a separate gated dependency.
proof_hooks: cargo fmt --all -- --check; cargo test --all-features; cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings; decapod validate
stop_conditions: Do not claim deployed Vercel/Neon parity or close live-proof issues without protected credentials and machine-readable live evidence.
Do not add organization, repository, membership, authorization, retry, idempotency, schema-policy, migration, or governance semantics to Dactyl.
Keep default SQLite tests network-free and preserve the existing public function signatures; any unsupported remote capability must fail with the existing typed contract.
